This page provides a compact overview of my current teaching profile and selected recent teaching activities. For official and updated course information, please refer to my [University of Florence teaching page](https://unifi.coursecatalogue.cineca.it/docente-id/68dcca81c0c746e140166a3f/2025).

::: teaching-card
## Current teaching

- `Comparative Politics`, undergraduate course, University of Florence
- `European Politics and Policy in the Contemporary World`, postgraduate course, University of Florence
:::

::: teaching-card
## Teaching interests

My teaching mainly covers comparative politics, European politics, legislative studies, public policy, and research methods. When relevant, I also integrate training on data analysis in R and empirical research design.
:::

::: teaching-card
## Selected recent activities

- April 2025: workshop for the PhD programme in Public Administration at the University of Milano-Bicocca on NextGenerationEU, national recovery plans, and implementation.
- 2023: introductory module on the R language for the Master in Digital Transformation, University of Florence.
- 2022 and 2025: course on data analysis in R at the Scuola Superiore di Catania.
- 2022-2025: teaching related to the Jean Monnet Module REPLAN-EU and European political economy.
:::
